info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Issued Device Status Update API
info.description: The Issued Device Status Update API allows businesses to modify the status or details of devices that have been issued to employees or clients. This endpoint is essential for organizations that need to maintain accurate records of device allocations and facilitate updates as circumstances change. Typical consumers include IT departments and asset management teams who manage device inventories. Through this API, users can perform essential updates efficiently to ensure that device tracking information remains current and reliable.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the tracking information of an issued device identified by the specified resource ID. Use this operation to modify the current tracking status and additional details pertaining to the device.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the issued device tracking information for the specified resource. Ensure that the payload adheres to the schema defined for the update operation.

200.description: The request was completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
